messages:
Carla: Heads-up — staging canary 0.9.4 shows a p99 regression vs 0.9.3 after today's merge. CI perf-check failed. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/5234 :eyes:
Ben: Numbers?
ci-bot: perf-check failed:
- p99 latency (text-gen, seq=1024): baseline 42ms -> 72ms (+30ms, +71%)
- throughput: -12%
Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/5234 :warning:
Alice: That's a pretty big delta. Was anything kernel-related merged in the release window?
Dan: There was a kernel selector tweak in PR #1042 (prefer_fused_attn for seq >= 512). Also batching heuristics change in PR #1039 (dynamic_batch_max 64 -> 96).
Siva: Also saw a KV cache TTL/eviction change land in PR #1050 that touches the eviction/lock path.
Carla: This smells like kernel + KV interplay. Can someone run a quick git bisect locally? I'll prepare a perf script.
Carla: Suggested bisect command:
```
git bisect start
git bisect bad origin/release-0.9.4
git bisect good origin/release-0.9.3
git bisect run ./dev/perf/run_ci_perf.sh --model gpt-2-small --seq 1024 --iters 200
```
Ben: I can run on a p4d node. Will toggle KV cache ON/OFF to compare.
Ben: Also add env REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 to get kernel selection logs.
Ben: Quick update — ran a focused bisect over the merged range (6 commits). Current suspect: commit 9f3a7d1 from PR #1042 (kernel selector tweak).
Carla: Paste the perf output/artifacts? Any flamegraphs?
Ben: Perf excerpt from 9f3a7d1 run:
```
--- perf-run (commit: 9f3a7d1)
p99: 71.8ms
p50: 14.2ms
throughput: 88 tok/s
KV hitrate: 67%
kernel_selected: fused_attn_avx2 (layer 2)
notes: spike correlates with intermittent kernel fallback in later layers
```
Dan: Huh — fused_attn should be faster normally. Maybe we trigger a slow fallback path when the KV cache accessor holds locks or changes memory layout. PR #1050 did change lock granularity.
Siva: I reproduced locally: with KV cache disabled p99 ~43ms (baseline). With KV enabled, p99 spikes to ~70ms. So KV + new kernel selector interaction looks causal.
Carla: Can we try forcing the old selector heuristic? Ben, can you build an image with KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy and run the perf job with KV enabled?
Ben: Running now on the same instance...
Ben: Result: with KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy + KV enabled => p99 44.1ms (back to baseline). That strongly implicates the selector change.
Alice: That means we should block rollout until we revert or patch the selector heuristics.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for release-0.9.4 paused: manual rollback required.
Carla: I'll open a revert PR against release-0.9.4 for PR #1042 and include a targeted perf test that exercises KV+short-tail sequence combos.
Ben: I'll add additional diagnostic logging in the selector (sequence len histogram + KV state) and upload traces.
Dan: Uploaded bisect trace bundle to S3: s3://redwood-perf/bisect/1805556666/9f3a7d1.tar.gz
Carla: Next steps:
1) Revert PR #1042 on the release branch (Carla)
2) Add perf CI test that runs KV ON/OFF matrix (Siva)
3) Add selector diagnostics + follow-up fix (Ben)
4) Postmortem after revert and validation (team)
Carla: Assigning: Carla (revert), Ben (diagnostics), Siva (perf test).
Alice: :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll paste the diagnostic kernel logs once uploaded.
Siva: I'll prototype the CI matrix and try to reproduce on smaller instances to speed iteration.
Carla: Thanks all — holding the release until revert lands and CI confirms regression is fixed.
